name: Advisor Ω
ability: Each night, you learn two statements & choose one: it becomes true (if not true already).
flavor: It comes down to this, so it's up to you. All that's left: choose right.
firstNightReminder: Give two statements. The Advisor chooses one.
otherNightReminder: Give two statements. The Advisor chooses one.

name: Corpse Eater Ω
ability: If a good player was executed today, their Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned tonight & tomorrow day.
otherNightReminder: If a good player was executed today, mark their Townsfolk neighbors. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:

name: Sol Ω
ability: If evil would win, but your 1st vote today was for the Demon, your team wins.

name: Train Conductor Ω
ability: You start knowing how many sources of drunkenness & poisoning are in play.
firstNightReminder: Give a finger signal. (The Drunk counts.)

name: Vengeance Ω
ability: Each night*, a player that nominated you yesterday dies, even if you are dead.
otherNightReminder: If a player nominated Vengeance yesterday, they die. :reminder: :reminder:

name: Veteran Ω
ability: Each night*, learn which players died. Once per game, you may choose 1 of them: they live & you die instead.
flavor: I have fought my battles. These children, they are the future!!
otherNightReminder: Point to the players that died. The Veteran might choose one. :reminder: If they do, that player lives & the Veteran dies. :reminder: :reminder:
